Q6111.reason: Under O'Brien, a content-neutral littering ordinance that serves park cleanliness and is not aimed at suppressing the message may be applied to symbolic protest conduct.

Q8473.reason: Hektoen enteric agar grows Salmonella and Shigella, so a positive culture identifies Salmonella typhi; C. difficile and the protozoa, including Giardia, do not grow on that medium.

Q5467.reason: An unintentional killing caused by unlawful speeding is involuntary manslaughter; the facts show neither intent to kill nor the extreme recklessness required for depraved-heart murder.
